bar.tooltip-no-device: No NVIDIA GPU with runtime power management found

panel.title: Discrete GPU
panel.suspended-explainer: The discrete GPU is powered down and nothing is using it. No queries are being made — reading temperature or load would resume the GPU and cost battery.
panel.wake-warning: This resumes the GPU. It will go back to sleep on its own once nothing is using it.
panel.no-processes: No processes are using the GPU.
panel.backed-off: Nothing running — polling slowed down so the queries don't keep the GPU awake.

settings.hide-when-suspended-description: Remove the bar widget entirely while the GPU is asleep.
settings.status-interval-description: How often the kernel's runtime_status file is read. Free — this never touches the GPU.
settings.active-interval-description: How often nvidia-smi runs while the GPU is already awake. Minimum 5 s.
settings.idle-interval-description: Slower cadence used after three samples with no processes and no load.
settings.pci-address-description: Leave blank to auto-detect the first NVIDIA VGA device with runtime power management.
